title: Provider Delete Reconciliation Observation Ordering
problem: A29/A30 durably record and resume provider-delete observations, but an older observation arriving after a newer applied non-terminal observation could previously overwrite the newer registry state.

contract.serialization: single-host POSIX flock around ordering decision plus registry mutation
contract.equal_epoch_same_object_and_state: equivalent evidence; may be marked applied without state mutation
contract.equal_epoch_conflict: fail closed with SEP_PRIVACY_RECONCILE_EQUAL_EPOCH_CONFLICT and remain pending
contract.newer_observation: may mutate registry only after existing hash/reservation/terminal checks
contract.provider_delete_replay: forbidden; ordering recovery is local evidence application only

cases.expected: terminal downgrade rejected; observation remains pending
hash mismatch rejected and remains pending

cases.case: older pending survives crash, newer observation applied, then resume
cases.expected: old pending becomes superseded_stale; resume PASS
single-host serialization yields state of maximum applied observation epoch
